thread:
priya: Heads up — conversion failing for a new HF bring-up (xgen-7b-chat) when we convert safetensors shards + pinned revision. Chat templates end up with special tokens mapped to <unk> and responses miss system prompt.
josh: Reproduced locally. Hub download returns index.json with shard_count=3 but only 2 shard files listed. Then convert continues and shuffles weight-key renames. Log snippet:
```
ERROR: ValueError: expected shard 2 present in index.json but missing file. shard_count mismatch (3 != 2)
KeyError: 'embedding.weight' not found after rename
```
anna: Seen similar with the quantize pipeline where shard filenames are nonstandard (e.g. model.safetensors.pt.0). Converter assumes `*.safetensors.{i}` ordering. Also noticed `config.json` special_tokens_map references token ids that break when the tokenizer mapping step runs after weight-key renames.
priya: Filed a small PR to add a validation pass and a fallback to re-request index.json and validate presence of all shards before rename stage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hf-converter/pull/432. It also logs the hub-revision used. Can someone review?

josh: Quick workaround (for QA) — run:
```
python tools/hf_converter.py \ 
  --model-dir /tmp/xgen \ 
  --repair-index \ 
  --allow-incomplete-shards
redwood model upload --force /tmp/xgen/converted
```
That forces index repair and prevents early key renames.

ci-bot: build failed on PR#432 — unit test `test_tokenizer_special_tokens_preserved` failing. Trace shows `<|pad|>` becomes `<unk>` in chat template rendering.

anna: Hypothesis: the weight-key rename step is mutating `config.json` or the intermediate token_map object because we canonicalize keys by name. We should preserve tokenizer special_tokens_map (copy before weight renames) and re-apply mapping to final tokenizer object after renames.

josh: I'll add a unit test to cover the end-to-end flow: nonstandard shard names + index repair + weight-key rename + tokenizer special_tokens_map preserved. Pushing in ~30m (branch: josh/repair-order-tests).

priya: Also noticed some failures come from HF hub auth expiry — downloader returns HTTP 401 and our retry path treats it as a soft failure and continues with partial files. We should treat 401 as fatal and trigger reauth flow instead of partial conversion. Filed issue #789 in infra.

hf-bot: Note: HF token scopes changed for org repos; downloader will attempt `hf_hub_download` with `use_auth_token=True` now and log the token scope.

anna: :thumbsup: If Josh can get the test in, I can run the quantized 4-bit builds through the new path and validate no special-token regressions for chat templates.

josh: wip — pushed branch `josh/repair-order-tests` with failing test and a proposed fix for ordering.

priya: Thanks — I'll run a canary on Dedicated after merge and report back. Will DM when the canary completes.
